events.summary: Two Teatro Real technical-assistance awards expose complete buyer, supplier, date and paid amount: €4,000 and €4,900 ex VAT. Gate moves provisionally to 2/3; primary payloads and buyer/supplier diversity remain unverified.

The CI arena closed after held-out failure and causal-feature novelty screening: COLEMAN/CONSTANTINE already covers the plausible contextual variables, while retained datasets lack a uniform current-change-to-test signal. No leader; next gate is a three-domain admission screen.

Alcobendas's official decree awards a €6,534 VAT-included CAE advisory/emission contract to ENERGON. Paid-comparable gate reaches 3/3 across two buyers; MITECO's current delegated-subject list does not include ENERGON, so regulated execution must be separated or partnered.

Exactly three non-communication domains screened. Index selection ranks first but remains unadmitted until its public PostgreSQL/HypoPG judge executes; solver selection held in reserve; compiler phase ordering rejected.

Revenue N6 paid-category evidence and Asset A6 guided-intake capability now form a testable crossover. A ten-case judge requires ≥95% completeness, zero invented evidence or regulated-boundary violations, and ≥40% lower median scoping time; no integrated result yet.

Official PLACSP deeplinks were recovered for Teatro Real 26000777 and 26000794. A secondary table marks 26000794 finalizado on 30 Jun 2026, but no primary payload, acceptance, invoice or payment evidence was recovered; N6 remains unchanged.

Registry reconciled to the stronger request-level reliability falsification already recorded in CURRENT: two of three root responses were HTTP 500 from EMFILE/ChunkLoadError; 21 denotes grouped stack occurrences, not independent requests. A6 retained, fitness 0.34; no pilot before repair.
Official PLACSP award payload for Teatro Real 26000794 was archived, confirming SINCEO2, EUR 4,000 ex VAT and planned June execution; acceptance, invoice and payment remain unproven.
The public PostgreSQL/HypoPG index-selection judge cannot execute because this runtime lacks PostgreSQL, HypoPG, psycopg2 and container engines. No benchmark or candidate claim was produced.

Paradores budgeted EUR 57,100/year (EUR 285,500 maximum estimated value) for an integral nationwide CAE service, but public mirrors conflict between annulled and pending/published. Counted as buyer/category-scale intent, not realized WTP; official outcome is now a gate.

A four-year national FEMP framework validates the three-phase municipal CAE Owner Pack and fixed-plus-variable economics; prime-team requirements shift the capturable route to tooling or subcontracting for eventual awardees. No awardee or pilot yet.
FEMP CC.-02/2026 progressed from bidding to evaluation after the 15 Jul deadline. No awardee or awarded economics are public; N6/0.68 and the supplier-channel gate are unchanged.
Official openrouter/free removes fixed-slug retirement risk, but a fresh root HTTP 500 confirms independent EMFILE remains; no deployment or merchant pilot yet.
A direct production-root probe returned HTTP 500 and fresh telemetry again identified EMFILE/ChunkLoadError on the current READY deployment. Repair-first gate and pilot hold remain unchanged.
Direct root 500 and editorial model 404 both freshly recurred on the unchanged production deployment; repair-first gate holds and merchant pilot remains unsafe.
